worldcombat.skill.craftyshield.summary: Weaves a lattice of trick sigils over the user and nearby allies, turning whole status moves aside. The lattice is held up by a limited number of glyphs and falls once a few are spent; damaging moves pass straight through.
worldcombat.skill.craftyshield.use.0: Turn aside a blanket of conditions and debuffs
worldcombat.skill.craftyshield.use.1: Weave the lattice before a taunt or lock lands
worldcombat.skill.craftyshield.use.2: Cover an ally about to step in from status moves
worldcombat.skill.craftyshield.descripti: The lattice turns %1$s hostile status moves aside and holds for about %2$s s.
The lattice covers %1$s blocks with about %2$s hovering glyphs.
worldcombat.skill.craftyshield.weave.fin: Fine: deflections x1.3, duration x1.15, radius x0.9, at +2 ticks wind-up and x1.1 cooldown — turns more aside and holds tight.
worldcombat.skill.craftyshield.weave.bro: Broad: radius x1.2, deflections x0.75, duration x0.85, in exchange for -1 tick wind-up and x0.88 cooldown — wide and quick to weave.
worldcombat.skill.craftyshield.timing: Self move, covering a %1$s block radius; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.craftyshield.preferenc: Fine: deflections x1.3, duration x1.15, radius x0.9, +2 ticks wind-up, x1.1 cooldown — turns more aside and holds tight, good for holding one spot. Broad: radius x1.2, deflections x0.75, duration x0.85, -1 tick wind-up, x0.88 cooldown — wide and quick, good for covering scattered allies.
The partner only considers weaving the lattice while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee pressure, larger prepares from farther away.
Under pressure: only while a foe is attacking the partner or its owner, or the partner was just hurt. Anytime: weave on any threat.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to weave the lattice.
world_combat.move.craftyshield.text.defl: The lattice turns the status move aside
